content: श्रवणः, -णम् [शृणोत्यनेन श्रु-क्रणे ल्युट्] .²1 The ear; ध्वनति मधुपसमूहे श्रवणमपिदवाति <ls>Gīt. 5</ls>; श्रवणाञ्जलिपुटपेयं विरचितवान् भारताख्यममृतं यः <ls>Ve. 1. 4</ls>. .²2 The hypotenuse of a triangle. .{@-णः, -णा@} <ab>N.</ab> of a lunar mansion containing three stars. .{@-णम्@} .²1 The act of hearing; श्रवणसुभगम् <ls>Me. 11</ls>. .²2 Study. .²3 Fame, glory. .²4 That which is heard or revealed, the Veda; इति श्रवणात् ‘because of such a Vedic text’. .²5 Wealth. .²6 Flowing, oozing. .²7 (In <ab>phil.</ab>) The determining by means of the six signs the true doctrine of the Vedānta.
